item.description: ### Added - **Field differences:** the ZIA dry run shows, for each rule already in the tenant, every field where it differs from what the wizard would send (as the tenant has it → as the plan has it). - **Update in place:** a ZIA rule the wizard made that differs is updated to match (keeping its position and whether it's switched on), and so is the wizard's DLP engine when its dictionaries changed; a ZPA application segment with other destinations or ports gets the application's. Undo puts each back, unless someone changed it since. A switch on each Dry Run page leaves them as they are instead. - **Licences:** once connected, Home lists the tenant's licences against what a POV shows (missing core ones, optional ones, subscriptions ending within 21 days); Customize marks modules the tenant isn't licensed for and takes the Cloud Sandbox licence from the subscriptions. - **Check for Drift:** next to Undo for ZIA and ZPA runs, it reads back what the run created or updated and lists what was deleted, renamed or changed since. It changes nothing. - **Summary report:** from ZIA's Apply page, as Markdown or a printable page: the policy and its rules, this session's results in every module, licences, warnings and follow-ups. No keys or passwords are in it. - **Bulk Rule Manager** (⌘6): the tenant's ZIA rules (the wizard's by default) to delete in bulk, with ZPA's and ZDX's Manage lists beside them.
